synthetic: every key, token, password and id here was generated for this recording in a throwaway directory against in-memory manager doubles; none is in use anywhere

layout.keyring/keyring-N.json: keyring files as `Keyring.save` writes them (1 key; 2 keys after rotate; narrowed)
layout.keyring/secret_versions.json: secret_versions rows (base64 nonce/ciphertext, the exact AAD text, the plaintext) under each keyring: a Rust SecretStore must decrypt every row
layout.migrations/migrations.json: every migration: version, name, checksum, exact statement text
layout.migrations/schema-vNN.json: sqlite_master (rowid order) and schema_migrations after migrations 1..NN
layout.subscriptions/subscriptions.db: SQLite database snapshot taken before the first fetch (with its master key subscriptions-master-key.json); open it with that keyring
layout.subscriptions/subscriptions.json: GET/HEAD /s/{token} exchanges: request (path, query, Accept, User-Agent, If-None-Match, Host) → status, headers in order, body by sha256 in `bodies`
layout.clients/client_cursor.json: GET /api/clients?limit=… pages following next_cursor, plus invalid cursors
layout.routing/routing.json: routing preview/put/apply/explain/history/rollback per protocol and policy, and the documents each manager double held after the apply
layout.fleet/fleet.json: desired_generations (document_json, digest, content_digest, canonical wire JSON), observed/managed rows on both sides and the central↔node HTTP exchanges
layout.links/tt_links.json: tt:// deep links: encode_deeplink inputs → link → decode_deeplink
layout.errors/error_bodies.json: status, headers and body of every error class (framework, auth, validation, managers, routing codes, fleet refusals, node-side fleet conflicts, metrics)
layout.audit/audit.json: audit_log rows (exact detail_json) and events of every scenario database
